edges: Robur kidnaps the secretary, president, and valet of the Weldon Institute.
Robur takes the Weldon Institute members on a journey around the world.
The Weldon Institute members escape to a small inhabited island after the Albatross explosion.
The Weldon Institute members return to Philadelphia aboard the Go-ahead.
Robur returns the Weldon Institute members to the ground after demonstrating his superiority.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Robur intrudes on a meeting of the Weldon Institute.
The Albatross reappears during the Go-ahead's maiden voyage.
Robur delivers a speech to the crowd after his demonstration.
The Albatross is damaged in a storm and later explodes.
